name: gateway_platforms_api_server_normalize_multimodal_content
notes: FIXED REAL PORT STUB: src/gateway/api_server_ports.c::aps_normalize_multimodal_content was a passthrough printf stub; replaced with a real implementation of gateway/platforms/api_server.py::_normalize_multimodal_content (+ _normalize_chat_content scalar/nested fallback): None->"", str truncation at 65536, text-part normalization, image URL validation (http(s)/data:image/), detail validation, file/unknown rejection via {'error': 'code:message'} (LIVE raises ValueError with the same 'code:message' string). Harness links the REAL port via extra_src and calls it per input; branch ladder is traced off the input in identical rung order on both sides; value event is a canonical encoding derived from the port's JSON output / LIVE result so libjson serialization formatting cannot red-flag diffs. Truncation-at-65536 branch is not exercised by inputs (would require a >64KB argv entry); all other branches covered.
